name: TalentVista
summary: AI screening and interview platform for aviation recruiting. It parses pilot, engineer and mechanic CVs, ranks candidates against the role, and runs role-specific structured interviews with AI-generated reports. Backed by an Innovate UK grant.
paragraphs: AI screening and interview platform for aviation recruiting. It parses pilot, engineer and mechanic CVs, ranks candidates against the role, and runs role-specific structured interviews with AI-generated reports. Backed by an Innovate UK grant.
whyItMatters: Useful when a posting pulls in hundreds of applications and your one recruiter cannot screen them all. Keep a human on the final shortlist and check how it scores certifications before you rely on it.
